data.body: [P1] Approach: Complete the required design note. This introduces a public option, but the PR's Summary/Why does not include the simplification alternatives required by rules 2 and 3, what the chosen design removes, or a reference to maintainer agreement. The implementation adds session state and a second recovery path without explaining why simplifying the existing resume flow is insufficient. Return to the design phase under rule 8 and obtain agreement on those choices before proceeding.
